name: Annual Meadow-grass
desc: Annual Meadow-grass (Poa annua): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Poa annua, or annual meadow grass, is a widespread low-growing turfgrass in temperate climates. Notwithstanding the reference to annual plant in its name, perennial biotypes do exist.
